shots.description: Night, moonlight spilling on porch. Tí stands alone at railing holding unlit red star lantern. Down the lane, kids-group passes with glowing lanterns, laughter implied. Porch lanterns sway gently.
Night, faint porch light. Tí's cupped hands shield candle; a gust blows flame out. Red cellophane ripples. Star-lantern dark again. Tí's shoulders drop.
Night, warm interior glow spills from doorway. Grandfather steps out onto porch, bamboo-shade under arm. He pauses beside Tí, silent, eyes on dark lantern.
Night, hands in focus. Grandfather's weathered fingers lower bamboo-shade over star-lantern top. Candle catches, flame steadies, red panels glow warm. Subtle drop shadows layer.
Night, golden moonlight. Tí runs down lane, star-lantern glowing bright, joining kids-group. Lanterns sway, shadows stretch. Street depth layers: fences, poles, moon.
Night, moonlight pools on threshold. Grandfather leans on gate post, silhouette against moon. Gentle smile, eyes follow Tí. Bamboo-shade absent now. Gate frames him.
Night, full moon centered. Silhouettes of star, carp, rabbit lanterns drift across face. Clouds barely move. Zoom deepens into moon glow, then fade to black.
